meta.title: ntfy Push Notifications
meta.description: Pushes approval waits, questions, turn ends, errors and subagent/workflow completions to any ntfy server — self-hosted URL, token/basic/no auth — and lets you approve or answer right from the phone notification.

ui.title: ntfy push notifications
ui.desc: Push approval waits, questions, turn ends, errors, subagent and workflow completions to your ntfy server — then approve or answer from the phone notification.
ui.testNeedsSaved: "Send test" uses the saved configuration; save changes first.
ui.replyNotReadyHint: Replies are unavailable right now: reply buttons are off, or the Host cannot resolve a public reply base URL (a publicly reachable DSH address is required).
ui.serverUrlHint: ntfy root URL, e.g. https://ntfy.sh or http://192.168.1.10:2586. Self-hosted and private addresses are allowed.
ui.topicHint: Topic your phone subscribes to; leave empty to disable pushing.
ui.usernameHint: Basic-auth username. Not a secret, stored in the config.
ui.tokenHint: Leave empty to keep the saved token. Tokens go to the DSH credential store and are never echoed here.
ui.passwordHint: Leave empty to keep the saved password. Passwords go to the DSH credential store and are never echoed here.
ui.eventsHint: Only the checked event kinds are pushed.
ui.eventsNone: No events selected — nothing will be pushed.
ui.clickTemplateHint: URL opened by tapping the notification; empty uses the DSH address. Supports {sessionId} and {title}.
ui.replyEnabledHint: Approvals get approve / reject; single-choice questions with ≤ 2 options get one button per option. ntfy allows at most 3 actions.
ui.replyTtlHint: How long a one-time reply token stays valid, 30–86400 seconds.
ui.replyBaseHint: Phone buttons hit this public address; tokens are one-time, signed, and carry no DSH login credentials.
ui.quietBypassHint: Priority 5 events (approvals, errors) are still pushed during quiet hours.
ui.minIntervalHint: Minimum gap between pushes of the same kind in one session; 0 = no limit.
ui.preview: Include a text preview on turn-end notifications
ui.previewHint: Appends the tail of the last assistant message, up to 160 characters.
ui.errInvalidUrl: The server URL must start with http:// or https://.
ui.errNotConfigured: Server URL or topic is not configured, so a test cannot be sent.
ui.clickModeHint: Auto sign-in appends this process's login token to the URL, so a phone opens DSH already signed in (the token rotates on restart and appears in the ntfy message); plain address needs the phone browser to have a live DSH cookie.
ui.webPromptDelayHint: 0 = show the web prompt immediately (it disappears by itself once the phone answers, recommended); above 0 = wait this long for the phone first, and the web card never appears if the phone answers inside this window.
